mapper.select: SELECT o.*, s.supplier_name, w.warehouse_name, u1.real_name as applicant_name, u2.real_name as approver_name, d.dept_name FROM biz_purchase_order o LEFT JOIN biz_supplier s ON o.supplier_id = s.id LEFT JOIN biz_warehouse w ON o.warehouse_id = w.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u1 ON o.applicant_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u2 ON o.approver_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON o.dept_id = d.id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted = 0
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM biz_purchase_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status >= 1 AND apply_time >= #{startTime} AND apply_time < #{endTime}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM biz_purchase_order WHERE deleted = 0 AND status >= 1 AND apply_time >= #{startTime} AND apply_time < #{endTime}
